title: By work order and line lists whole work orders and no-charge lines with figures
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location has no accounting integration (neither QuickBooks Online nor AccountingHub).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B.
  • Have a new invoiced work order for this test, work order 4, for customer B.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, closed, closed on the 3rd of this month, with 2 stock parts at $40.00 ($80.00), one special-order part billed at $125.00, 2.0 labor hours and Shop supplies $15.00.
  • Have a new No Charge work order for this test, work order 2, for customer B, category Warranty, closed, closed on the 2nd of this month, with 1 stock part at $80.00, 1.0 labor hour and work order 4 as its original work order.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 3, for customer B, invoiced, billable, invoiced on the 1st of this month, whose line 2 of 1.5 hours was No Charge under Goodwill with one stock part costing $40.00.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports > Internal Work Orders.
  2. Set the date range to this month.
  3. Set the Classification filter to "All".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report opens on the "By work order and line" tab.

Step 2:

  • The range is this month.

Step 3:

  • Work order 1 reads Line "Whole work order", customer A, Internal, General Internal, Closed / invoiced on the 3rd, Parts cost $205.00 ($80.00 + $125.00), Shop supplies $15.00, Hours 2.0.
  • Work order 2 reads "Whole work order", No Charge, Warranty, Original work order work order 4 (a link), Parts cost $80.00, Hours 1.0.
  • Work order 3 reads line 2's number and title, No Charge line, Goodwill, the invoice date, Parts cost $40.00, Shop supplies empty, Hours 1.5.
  • Rows are sorted newest first: work order 1, work order 2, work order 3.
  • The totals row reads Parts cost $325.00, Shop supplies $15.00 and Hours 4.5.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close), story SV-11766 (Story 9, Reports, dashboard and exports)

  • S9-R2: “The report "Internal Work Orders" under Reports lists the closed internal and no-charge work orders of the organization and, one row each, the no-charge lines of invoiced billable work orders. Filters: date range on the posting or invoice date (default this month, at most 12 months), Location (all or one), Classification (All / Internal / No Charge / No Charge line), Category (All or one, archived under a heading), Original technician (All or one). Above the table a summary strip shows one card per category in the range: parts cost, count of work orders and lines, hours. Two tabs. "By work order and line", columns: Work order (link), Line ("Whole work order", or the line number and title), Customer, Classification, Category, Original work order (link, with the original line number when set), Original technician, Closed / invoiced (the posting date, or the invoice date for a line), Parts cost (one number: stock parts plus special orders and sublet, as on the NO CHARGE document, S3-R5; for a line, its own parts), Shop supplies (empty on a line), Hours (the labor hours on the lines, as on the document; clocked hours per technician are in Technician Efficiency with Only internal); a totals row for the whole range, not the page; rows sorted by date, newest first. "By technician", one row per technician with the columns Completed lines (lines with status Complete in the range on which the technician clocked time, the definition Technician Efficiency uses, so the two reports agree), Comeback lines and Warranty lines (no-charge lines of those categories whose stored original technicians include this technician, S2-R17), Comeback rate (comeback lines / completed lines), Redo hours and Redo parts cost (the hours and parts cost of that comeback and warranty work). A whole no-charge Comeback or Warranty work order counts as one line in this tab, with all its hours and parts cost. A line with several technicians counts once for each of them, in the numerator and the denominator, hours and cost shown whole for each; the totals row counts every line once; a note under the table says so. A row "Unassigned" holds the work without an original technician (Not in ShopView, or no technician on the original). The dollar cost of labor arrives with labor posting. Export: the PDF carries both tabs as sections with the same columns; the CSV carries the tab that is open, as every export gives what is on screen.”
  • S9-R11: “With Show all on Technician Efficiency, internal and no-charge work orders count as work orders with their hours and no sales. In the export, internal and no-charge rows carry 0.00 on every line, their Classification and their Category (S9-R6); a no-charge line of a billable work order carries 0.00 on its own row with its Category. Every report, the export and the asset Invoices tab date a closed record by its posting date and a no-charge line by its invoice date.”
  • S2-R16: “A no-charge work order always carries one category from the No Charge list, set at creation (S2-R2) or at conversion (S2-R5) and editable with Change category (S2-R6) until Close. It shows in the Change category dialog, on the NO CHARGE document and the estimate under the masthead ("Category: Warranty", with "· Original work order S2-30455" only when the original is a real work order, never "Not in ShopView"), in the notes and the audit log, in the Internal Work Orders report (S9-R2), in the Customer Invoice export (S9-R6), in the hub record (S8-R1) and in the Open API (S2-R12). It is not shown on the work order detail or in lists; the badge is the only mark there. The category decides the account the parts cost posts to (Stories 5 to 8). Internal work orders carry an Internal category resolved by S2-R1.”
  • Key Decisions: “One report for free work; the money reports leave internal and no-charge work orders out with no filter.”
